title: Stage-Indexed Interaction Structure Across Development
scientific_scope: The complete frozen stage-indexed interaction table, including anonymous interaction and cell-pair identifiers, association values, and interaction-strength-like measurements.
analysis_unit: One interaction-cell-pair combination followed across ordered stages; repeated stages for the same pair are dependent.
missingness: No curator-imposed row deletion, random subsampling, or imputation is applied within the frozen task boundary.
license_boundary: The complete selected source-data table is CC BY and is bundled with biological identities removed while retaining ordered stage and numerical structure.
warnings: Association strength and p-values do not uniquely identify direct biological communication or causality.
Interaction or cell-pair families must be held out intact when testing stage generalization.
source_coverage_statement: The bundled files are complete within the scientific_scope declared for this task. This does not assert that every variable, record, or file in the upstream scientific source is included.
